name: Erlitou
note: Great Bronze Age site, often taken as the late Xia capital.
note_zh: 二里头文化大型都邑，多认为是夏代晚期都城。

name: Xibo
note: Yanshi Shang city, an early Shang capital.
note_zh: 偃师商城，商代早期都城之一。

name: Bo (Zhengzhou)
note: Zhengzhou Shang city, early Shang capital.
note_zh: 郑州商城，商代早期都城。

name: Zhengzhou
note: Railway junction of the Beijing–Hankou and Kaifeng–Luoyang lines.
note_zh: 京汉、汴洛铁路交汇，兴起为交通枢纽。

name: Yin
note: Late Shang capital after Pan Geng's move; oracle bones found here.
note_zh: 盘庚迁殷后的商都，出土甲骨文。

name: Ye
note: Cao Wei seat, then capital of Later Zhao, Former Yan, Eastern Wei and Northern Qi.
note_zh: 曹魏王都，后为后赵、冉魏、前燕、东魏、北齐都城。

name: Haojing
note: Western Zhou capital.
note_zh: 西周都城（宗周）。

name: Chang'an
note: Western Han capital, start of the Silk Road.
note_zh: 西汉都城，丝绸之路起点。

name: Chang'an
note: Key city of Guanzhong; capital of Former Qin, Western Wei, Northern Zhou and others.
note_zh: 关中重镇，前赵、前秦、后秦、西魏、北周相继建都。

name: Daxing
note: Sui capital built by Emperor Wen, basis of Tang Chang'an.
note_zh: 隋文帝新建都城，唐长安城前身。

name: Chang'an
note: Tang capital of about a million people, among the largest cities on earth.
note_zh: 唐都，人口百万，世界最大城市之一。

name: Jingzhao
note: After Tang, a regional centre of the northwest.
note_zh: 唐亡后降为西北重镇（宋京兆府、元奉元路）。

name: Xi'an
note: Provincial capital of Shaanxi under Ming and Qing.
note_zh: 明清陕西省城，西北军政中心。

name: Xianyang
note: Qin capital from 350 BCE.
note_zh: 秦孝公迁都于此，秦朝都城。

name: Yong
note: Capital of the state of Qin for three centuries.
note_zh: 春秋秦国都城近三百年。

name: Luoyi
note: Eastern capital founded by the Duke of Zhou.
note_zh: 周公营建的东都成周。

name: Luoyi
note: Eastern Zhou royal capital.
note_zh: 东周王城。

name: Luoyang
note: Largest city east of the passes.
note_zh: 三川郡治，关东第一大城。

name: Luoyang
note: Eastern Han capital, home of the Imperial Academy.
note_zh: 东汉都城，太学所在。

name: Luoyang
note: Capital of Wei and Western Jin, sacked in 311.
note_zh: 曹魏、西晋都城，311年永嘉之乱被焚。

name: Luoyang
note: Northern Wei capital after 494, full of Buddhist temples.
note_zh: 北魏孝文帝迁都，佛寺林立。

name: Eastern Capital
note: Sui–Tang eastern capital; Wu Zetian's 'Divine Capital'.
note_zh: 隋炀帝营建，唐东都，武周时为神都。

name: Western Capital
note: Later Liang/Later Tang capital, Song western capital.
note_zh: 后梁、后唐都城，北宋西京。

name: Daliang
note: Capital of the state of Wei.
note_zh: 战国魏国都城。

name: Bianzhou
note: Grand Canal hub and seat of the Xuanwu army.
note_zh: 运河枢纽，宣武军治所。

name: Dongjing (Bianliang)
note: Capital of most Five Dynasties and of Northern Song.
note_zh: 后梁至北宋都城，《清明上河图》所绘繁华。

name: Nanjing (Jin)
note: Jin capital after the flight from Zhongdu.
note_zh: 金宣宗南迁后的都城。

name: Kaifeng
note: Provincial capital of Henan.
note_zh: 河南省城。

name: Shangqiu (Song)
note: Capital of Song, fief of the Shang descendants.
note_zh: 宋国都城，商人后裔所封。

name: Southern Capital
note: Song southern capital, where the dynasty's founder rose.
note_zh: 北宋应天府南京，宋太祖龙兴之地。

name: Linzi
note: Qi capital, richest city of the Warring States, seat of the Jixia Academy.
note_zh: 齐国都城，战国最繁华城市，稷下学宫所在。

name: Linzi
note: One of the five great cities of Han.
note_zh: 齐郡治，汉代五大都会之一。

name: Qufu
note: Capital of Lu, Confucius's home town.
note_zh: 鲁国都城，孔子故乡。

name: Qufu
note: Home of the Confucius temple and the Kong family.
note_zh: 孔府、孔庙所在，衍圣公世居。

name: Ying
note: Chu capital until sacked by Qin in 278 BCE.
note_zh: 楚国都城纪南城，278年为秦白起攻破。

name: Jiangling
note: Seat of Jingzhou, the military key of the middle Yangtze.
note_zh: 荆州治所，长江中游军事重镇。

name: Handan
note: Capital of Zhao.
note_zh: 赵国都城。

name: Handan
note: One of the five great cities of Han.
note_zh: 汉代五大都会之一。

name: Xinzheng
note: Capital of Zheng, then of Han.
note_zh: 郑国、后为韩国都城。

name: Xintian
note: Capital of Jin.
note_zh: 晋国都城。

name: Ji
note: Capital of Yan.
note_zh: 燕国都城。

name: Youzhou
note: Northern frontier base, seat of An Lushan's Fanyang command.
note_zh: 东北边防重镇，安禄山范阳节度使治所。

name: Yanjing
note: Liao southern capital.
note_zh: 辽南京析津府。

name: Zhongdu
note: Jin capital.
note_zh: 金朝都城。

name: Dadu (Khanbaliq)
note: Yuan capital, Marco Polo's Khanbaliq.
note_zh: 元朝都城，马可·波罗笔下的汗八里。

name: Beiping
note: Fief of the Prince of Yan.
note_zh: 燕王朱棣封地。

name: Beijing
note: Ming and Qing capital.
note_zh: 明成祖迁都，明清都城。

name: Jianye
note: Capital of Wu.
note_zh: 孙吴都城。

name: Jiankang
note: Capital of Eastern Jin and the Southern Dynasties.
note_zh: 东晋、宋、齐、梁、陈都城，六朝古都。

name: Jinling
note: Razed by Sui in 589, later a Tang regional city.
note_zh: 隋灭陈后被毁，唐代为江南名城。

name: Jiangning
note: Capital of Southern Tang.
note_zh: 南唐都城。

name: Jiankang
note: Major city of the lower Yangtze.
note_zh: 宋元江南重镇，南宋行都之一。

name: Yingtian (Nanjing)
note: Early Ming capital.
note_zh: 明初都城。

name: Nanjing
note: Ming secondary capital; Qing seat of the Liangjiang viceroy; Taiping capital 1853–64.
note_zh: 明南京留都，清两江总督驻地；1853—1864年为太平天国天京。

name: Hangzhou
note: Southern end of the Grand Canal.
note_zh: 大运河南端。

name: Hangzhou (Wuyue)
note: Capital of Wuyue.
note_zh: 吴越国都城。

name: Hangzhou
note: 'Paradise above, Suzhou and Hangzhou below.'
note_zh: “上有天堂，下有苏杭”。

name: Lin'an
note: Southern Song capital, over a million people.
note_zh: 南宋行在，人口逾百万。

name: Hangzhou
note: Marco Polo's Quinsai; Zhejiang provincial capital.
note_zh: 元代马可·波罗称为“行在”，明清浙江省城。

name: Wu
note: Capital of the state of Wu.
note_zh: 吴国都城，伍子胥筑城。

name: Wu (Suzhou)
note: Seat of Wu commandery, home of the great southern clans.
note_zh: 吴郡治所，江东大族顾陆朱张聚居。

name: Suzhou
note: Economic and cultural centre of Jiangnan.
note_zh: 江南经济文化中心，明清最富庶城市之一。

name: Kuaiji
note: Capital of Yue, where Goujian plotted revenge.
note_zh: 越国都城，勾践卧薪尝胆。

name: Kuaiji (Shaoxing)
note: Home of the great clans of the Southern Dynasties.
note_zh: 东晋南朝士族聚居之地。

name: Guangling
note: Founded with the Han canal; Han kingdom of Wu.
note_zh: 吴王夫差开邗沟筑城，汉吴国都城。

name: Yangzhou
note: Canal–Yangtze junction; richest Tang city; salt-merchant capital later.
note_zh: 运河与长江交汇，唐“扬一益二”，明清盐商之都。

name: Jinsha
note: Shu centre after Sanxingdui (Jinsha site, west Chengdu), known for its sun-bird gold foil.
note_zh: 三星堆之后的古蜀中心都邑（今成都西郊金沙遗址），出土太阳神鸟金饰。

name: Chengdu
note: Capital of the ancient state of Shu (the Kaiming kings moved here from Pi; dates uncertain).
note_zh: 古蜀国都城：杜宇都郫，开明氏徙治成都（年代不详，均在成都平原）。

name: Chengdu
note: One of the five great cities of Han.
note_zh: 秦灭蜀后筑城，汉代五大都会之一。

name: Chengdu
note: Capital of Shu-Han.
note_zh: 蜀汉都城。

name: Chengdu
note: Second city of Tang; refuge of Xuanzong in 756.
note_zh: 唐“扬一益二”，安史之乱时玄宗避难于此。

name: Chengdu
note: Capital of Former and Later Shu.
note_zh: 前蜀、后蜀都城。

name: Chengdu
note: Where the first paper money, jiaozi, was issued.
note_zh: 北宋发行交子，世界最早纸币。

name: Jiangzhou
note: A seat of the state of Ba (Ba moved its capital several times).
note_zh: 巴国都邑之一（巴都屡迁，江州为其一）。

name: Jiangzhou (Yu)
note: Seat of Ba commandery, later Yuzhou.
note_zh: 巴郡治所，后称渝州。

name: Chongqing
note: Centre of Song mountain-fort resistance to the Mongols.
note_zh: 南宋抗蒙山城防御中心（钓鱼城）。

name: Panyu
note: Capital of Nanyue.
note_zh: 南越国都城。

name: Panyu (Guangzhou)
note: Southern port; Tang trade office and Arab merchant quarter.
note_zh: 南海郡治，唐代设市舶使，阿拉伯商人云集。

name: Xingwang
note: Capital of Southern Han.
note_zh: 南汉都城。

name: Guangzhou
note: Qing's only open port for Western trade (Thirteen Factories).
note_zh: 清代一口通商（十三行）。

name: Quanzhou (Zayton)
note: Largest port of the Song–Yuan world, Marco Polo's Zayton.
note_zh: 宋元东方第一大港，马可·波罗称刺桐。

name: Mingzhou (Ningbo)
note: Port for Japan and Korea; treaty port 1842.
note_zh: 对日本、高丽贸易港，明代勘合贸易口岸；1842年开埠。

name: Fuzhou
note: Old Minyue capital; Fujian's capital and naval yard.
note_zh: 闽越都城东冶，后为福建首府，船政局所在。

name: Xiakou
note: Naval base where the Han meets the Yangtze.
note_zh: 长江与汉水交汇处的军港，孙吴江夏重镇。

name: Wuchang (Ezhou)
note: Capital of Huguang; Wuchang Uprising of 1911.
note_zh: 鄂州、武昌府，湖广首府；1911年武昌起义。

name: Xiangyang
note: Key of north–south war; besieged six years by the Mongols.
note_zh: 南北必争之地，宋元襄樊之战六年。

name: Changsha
note: Han kingdom of Changsha (Mawangdui); Chu capital in the Five Dynasties.
note_zh: 汉长沙国（马王堆）、五代楚国都城、湖南省城。

name: Yuzhang (Hongzhou)
note: Capital of Jiangxi, home of the Tengwang Pavilion.
note_zh: 江西首府，滕王阁所在。

name: Hefei
note: Wei frontier fortress; Sun Quan failed to take it again and again.
note_zh: 曹魏对吴前线，张辽逍遥津之战，孙权多次攻而不克。

name: Luzhou (Hefei)
note: Southern Song stronghold on the Huai front.
note_zh: 南宋两淮防线要地。

name: Shouchun
note: Last capital of Chu.
note_zh: 楚国最后都城。

name: Shouchun
note: Huainan stronghold near the Fei River battlefield.
note_zh: 淮南重镇，淝水之战前线。

name: Pengcheng (Xuzhou)
note: Xiang Yu's capital; a battleground of every age.
note_zh: 西楚霸王项羽都城，兵家必争之地。

name: Xu
note: Cao Cao moved the last Han emperor here.
note_zh: 曹操迎汉献帝都许。

name: Jinyang
note: Where Li Yuan rose; Tang northern capital; Shatuo base.
note_zh: 李渊起兵之地，唐北都，五代沙陀根据地。

name: Taiyuan
note: Rebuilt after Song razed Jinyang; Shanxi capital.
note_zh: 宋灭北汉后毁晋阳另筑新城，山西省城。

name: Pingcheng
note: Northern Wei capital; Yungang caves nearby.
note_zh: 北魏前期都城，近郊有云冈石窟。

name: Western Capital (Liao)
note: Liao western capital.
note_zh: 辽西京大同府。

name: Datong
note: One of Ming's Nine Frontier Garrisons.
note_zh: 明九边重镇。

name: Guihua
note: Built by Altan Khan; Mongol–Chinese trade town.
note_zh: 阿勒坦汗所筑，蒙汉互市中心。

name: Yulin
note: Ming frontier garrison.
note_zh: 明延绥镇治所，九边之一。

name: Xingqing
note: Capital of Western Xia.
note_zh: 西夏都城。

name: Ningxia
note: Ming frontier garrison.
note_zh: 明九边宁夏镇。

name: Jincheng (Lanzhou)
note: Yellow River crossing at the gate of the Hexi Corridor.
note_zh: 黄河渡口，河西走廊门户。

name: Guzang (Liangzhou)
note: Seat of Liangzhou; largest city of the Hexi Corridor.
note_zh: 凉州治所，五凉都城，河西第一大城。

name: Zhangye (Ganzhou)
note: One of the four Hexi commanderies.
note_zh: 河西四郡之一，隋炀帝在此会见西域诸国。

name: Jiuquan (Suzhou)
note: One of the four Hexi commanderies, near Jiayu Pass.
note_zh: 河西四郡之一，近嘉峪关。

name: Dunhuang (Shazhou)
note: Silk Road gateway, home of the Mogao caves.
note_zh: 丝路咽喉，莫高窟所在。

name: Gaochang
note: Capital of Gaochang, conquered by Tang in 640.
note_zh: 高昌国都城，640年为唐所灭。

name: Xizhou (Turpan)
note: Tang Xizhou, later Uyghur Qocho.
note_zh: 唐西州，后为回鹘高昌、吐鲁番。

name: Kucha
note: Great oasis kingdom; seat of the Tang Anxi Protectorate.
note_zh: 西域大国，唐安西都护府治所，鸠摩罗什故乡。

name: Kashgar
note: Western Tarim oasis; one of Tang's Four Garrisons.
note_zh: 塔里木西缘绿洲，唐安西四镇之一。

name: Khotan
note: Kingdom of jade; one of Tang's Four Garrisons.
note_zh: 玉石之国，安西四镇之一。

name: Dihua
note: Qing city; capital of Xinjiang province from 1884.
note_zh: 清代新疆重镇，1884年新疆建省后为省城。

name: Huiyuan (Ili)
note: Seat of the Ili General.
note_zh: 伊犁将军驻地，清代新疆军政中心。

name: Tingzhou (Beiting)
note: Seat of the Tang Beiting Protectorate.
note_zh: 唐北庭都护府治所。

name: Rasa (Lhasa)
note: Capital of the Tibetan Empire.
note_zh: 吐蕃都城。

name: Lhasa
note: Seat of the Ganden Phodrang and the Qing ambans.
note_zh: 甘丹颇章政权中心，清驻藏大臣驻地。

name: Shigatse
note: Tashilhunpo monastery, seat of the Panchen Lama.
note_zh: 扎什伦布寺，班禅驻锡地。

name: Sakya
note: Centre of Sakya rule over Tibet under the Yuan.
note_zh: 元代萨迦派主政西藏的中心。

name: Xining
note: Gateway to Amdo; seat of the Qing Xining amban.
note_zh: 河湟重镇，近塔尔寺，清西宁办事大臣驻地。

name: Taihe
note: Capital of Nanzhao.
note_zh: 南诏都城。

name: Yangjumie
note: Capital of Nanzhao and the Dali kingdom.
note_zh: 南诏、大理国都城。

name: Tuodong (Shanchan)
note: Eastern capital of Nanzhao and Dali.
note_zh: 南诏东京、大理国鄯阐府。

name: Kunming
note: Capital of Yunnan from the Yuan.
note_zh: 元以后云南省城。

name: Guiyang
note: Capital of Guizhou province from 1413.
note_zh: 明设贵州布政使司后的省城。

name: Guilin (Shi'an)
note: Linked to the Yangtze by the Lingqu canal.
note_zh: 灵渠沟通湘漓，岭南西部重镇。

name: Yongzhou (Nanning)
note: Song frontier against Đại Việt and Nong Zhigao.
note_zh: 宋代对交趾、侬智高战事前线。

name: Qiongzhou
note: Seat of Hainan island.
note_zh: 海南岛治所，苏轼曾谪居儋州。

name: Jiaozhou
note: Han–Tang Jiaozhi; seat of the Annan Protectorate.
note_zh: 汉唐交趾郡、安南都护府治所。

name: Thăng Long
note: Capital of Vietnam's Lý, Trần and Lê dynasties.
note_zh: 越南李、陈、黎朝都城。

name: Lelang
note: Seat of the Han Lelang commandery.
note_zh: 汉乐浪郡治。

name: Pyongyang
note: Late Goguryeo capital.
note_zh: 高句丽后期都城。

name: Gungnae
note: Goguryeo capital, site of the Gwanggaeto stele.
note_zh: 高句丽都城，好太王碑所在。

name: Kaegyong
note: Capital of Goryeo.
note_zh: 高丽王朝都城。

name: Hanseong
note: Capital of Joseon.
note_zh: 朝鲜王朝都城。

name: Geumseong
note: Capital of Silla.
note_zh: 新罗都城。

name: Heijō-kyō
note: Japan's Nara-period capital, modelled on Chang'an.
note_zh: 日本奈良时代都城，仿长安。

name: Heian-kyō
note: Japan's capital for a thousand years.
note_zh: 日本千年古都。

name: Edo
note: Seat of the Tokugawa shogunate; renamed Tokyo in 1868.
note_zh: 德川幕府所在，1868年改称东京。

name: Shangjing (Liao)
note: Liao supreme capital.
note_zh: 辽上京临潢府。

name: Zhongjing (Liao)
note: Liao central capital.
note_zh: 辽中京大定府。

name: Liaoyang (Xiangping)
note: Seat of Liaodong; Liao eastern capital; Ming Liaodong command.
note_zh: 辽东郡治，辽东京，明辽东都司治所。

name: Shangjing (Jin)
note: Jin supreme capital.
note_zh: 金上京会宁府。

name: Mukden
note: Later Jin / Qing capital before 1644.
note_zh: 后金、清入关前都城。

name: Mukden
note: Qing secondary capital.
note_zh: 清陪都，留都盛京。

name: Hetu Ala
note: Where Nurhaci founded Later Jin.
note_zh: 努尔哈赤建后金之地。

name: Jinzhou
note: Ming stronghold of western Liaodong, lost in 1642.
note_zh: 明辽西重镇，1642年松锦之战后失守。

name: Karakorum
note: Capital of the Mongol Empire.
note_zh: 蒙古帝国都城。

name: Shangdu (Xanadu)
note: Yuan summer capital, Xanadu.
note_zh: 元夏都开平，忽必烈即位之地。

name: Rehe (Chengde)
note: Qing summer palace.
note_zh: 避暑山庄，清帝夏宫。

name: Tianjin
note: Ming garrison at the canal mouth; treaty port 1860.
note_zh: 明设天津卫，运河与海运枢纽；1860年开埠。

name: Licheng (Jinan)
note: Capital of Shandong.
note_zh: 齐州、济南府，明清山东省城。

name: Linqing
note: Grand Canal trade city.
note_zh: 明清运河商城，“富庶甲齐郡”。

name: Shanyang (Huai'an)
note: Canal–Huai junction; seat of the Grain Transport Viceroy.
note_zh: 运河与淮河交汇，明清漕运总督驻地。

name: Jingdezhen
note: The porcelain capital.
note_zh: 瓷都，宋景德年间得名。

name: Shanghai
note: County port of the cotton trade.
note_zh: 元设上海县，松江棉布贸易港。

name: Shanghai
note: Treaty port from 1843, largest in East Asia.
note_zh: 1843年开埠，远东最大商埠。

name: Hong Kong
note: Ceded to Britain in 1842.
note_zh: 1842年割让英国。

name: Macau
note: Portuguese settlement from 1557.
note_zh: 1557年葡萄牙人入居。

name: Xiamen (Amoy)
note: Zheng Chenggong's base; treaty port 1843.
note_zh: 郑成功根据地，1843年开埠。

name: Tainan (Zeelandia)
note: Dutch Fort Zeelandia; Zheng capital; Qing seat of Taiwan.
note_zh: 荷兰热兰遮城，郑氏东宁、清台湾府治。

name: Nanzheng
note: Seat of Qin's Hanzhong commandery, between the Qinling and Sichuan.
note_zh: 秦汉中郡治，扼秦岭与巴蜀之间。

name: Nanzheng
note: Liu Bang's capital as King of Han, the origin of the dynasty's name.
note_zh: 刘邦受封汉王，以此为都，“汉”之国号由此而来。

name: Hanzhong
note: Hanzhong commandery, the gate between Guanzhong and Sichuan.
note_zh: 汉中郡，关中与巴蜀之间的门户。

name: Hanzhong
note: Zhang Lu's Daoist state for 25 years, until he surrendered to Cao Cao in 215.
note_zh: 张鲁五斗米道政权据此近三十年，215年降曹操。

name: Hanzhong
note: Liu Bei took it in 219; base of Zhuge Liang's and Jiang Wei's northern campaigns.
note_zh: 219年刘备夺汉中称汉中王；诸葛亮、姜维以此为北伐基地，魏延“实兵诸围”拒守。

name: Hanzhong (Liangzhou)
note: Liangzhou / Xingyuan, the key between Shaanxi and Sichuan.
note_zh: 梁州/兴元府，川陕之间的要冲。

name: Xingyuan (Hanzhong)
note: Core of the Southern Song Sichuan–Shaanxi defence.
note_zh: 南宋川陕防线核心，与金、蒙古反复争夺。

name: Hanzhong
note: Ming–Qing prefecture of southern Shaanxi.
note_zh: 明清汉中府，陕南重镇。

name: Shanggui (Qinzhou)
note: Key town of Longyou, fought over in Zhuge Liang's campaigns.
note_zh: 陇右重镇，诸葛亮北伐争夺之地。

name: Gaoping (Yuanzhou)
note: Guards Xiao Pass; Ming frontier command.
note_zh: 萧关所在，丝路东段要冲，明三边总制驻地。

name: Xuanfu
note: Chief of the Ming frontier garrisons, shielding Beijing.
note_zh: 明九边之首，拱卫京师。

name: Jizhou
note: Ming Ji garrison held by Qi Jiguang.
note_zh: 明蓟镇，戚继光镇守。

name: Shuangyu
note: Smuggling port with Portuguese traders, destroyed 1548.
note_zh: 明代走私贸易港，葡萄牙人聚居，1548年被毁。

name: Shen
note: Capital of Shen, annexed by Chu.
note_zh: 申国都城，周宣王所封，后为楚所灭。

name: Wan (Nanyang)
note: Iron-working centre, one of the five great cities of Han.
note_zh: 冶铁重镇，汉代五大都会之一，光武帝起兵之地。

name: Tao
note: 'Centre of the world', where Fan Li grew rich in trade.
note_zh: “天下之中”，范蠡经商致富之地。

name: Jingkou (Zhenjiang)
note: Yangtze crossing; base of the Northern Garrison army.
note_zh: 长江渡口，东晋北府兵驻地。

name: Xunyang (Jiangzhou)
note: Middle Yangtze port of Bai Juyi's 'Pipa Song'.
note_zh: 长江中游要津，白居易《琵琶行》作于此。

name: Sanxingdui
note: Ancient Shu city, famous for its bronze masks.
note_zh: 古蜀国都邑，出土青铜纵目面具。

name: Panlongcheng
note: Shang southern outpost controlling Yangtze copper.
note_zh: 商朝南方据点，控制长江铜料。

name: Hankou
note: Treaty port and inland trade hub.
note_zh: 清末开埠，“九省通衢”。

name: Wuchang (Wu)
note: Sun Quan's capital until 229.
note_zh: 孙权由公安迁此，改鄂县为武昌并称帝，229年迁建业。

name: Wuchang (Wu)
note: Wu's military centre on the middle Yangtze.
note_zh: 孙吴长江中游军事中心。

name: Yiling
note: Shu–Wu border; Lu Xun routed Liu Bei here in 222.
note_zh: 蜀吴交界，222年陆逊火烧连营大败刘备。

name: Baidicheng
note: Guards the Qutang gorge; Liu Bei died here in 223.
note_zh: 扼瞿塘峡口，223年刘备托孤于此。

name: Chencang
note: 'Secretly crossing at Chencang'; held against Zhuge Liang in 228.
note_zh: “暗度陈仓”；228年郝昭以千余人拒诸葛亮。

name: Qishan
note: Zhuge Liang's route into Longyou.
note_zh: 诸葛亮北伐屡出祁山，攻取陇右的要道。

name: Xincheng (Fangling)
note: Three-way border; Meng Da's revolt crushed by Sima Yi in 228.
note_zh: 魏蜀吴三方交界，228年孟达反魏被司马懿速平。

name: Ruxu
note: Wu fort against Wei; 'a son should be like Sun Quan'.
note_zh: 孙吴筑坞抗曹魏，曹操叹“生子当如孙仲谋”。

name: Fancheng
note: Facing Xiangyang over the Han River; Guan Yu's flood victory of 219.
note_zh: 与襄阳隔汉水相望，219年关羽水淹七军。

name: Jiuyuan
note: End of the Qin Straight Road, facing the Xiongnu.
note_zh: 秦直道终点，北御匈奴。

name: Yunzhong
note: Northern frontier commandery since King Wuling of Zhao.
note_zh: 赵武灵王所置，汉北边重镇。

name: Mayi
note: Frontier town of the Mayi ambush of 133 BCE.
note_zh: 雁门郡要地，前133年马邑之谋。

name: Juyan
note: Han frontier fort, source of the Juyan bamboo slips.
note_zh: 汉代居延塞，出土大量汉简。

name: Xuanhu
note: Fought over by the Northern and Southern Dynasties.
note_zh: 南北朝淮北争夺要地。

name: Zhongli
note: Liang's great victory over Northern Wei in 507.
note_zh: 507年梁军在此大破北魏。

name: Yubi
note: Wei Xiaokuan held it against Gao Huan's 50-day siege in 546.
note_zh: 西魏韦孝宽据守，546年高欢围攻五十日不克。

name: Huaishuo
note: One of the Six Garrisons; Gao Huan's home.
note_zh: 北魏六镇之一，高欢出身于此。

name: Wuchuan
note: One of the Six Garrisons; home of the Yuwen, Yang and Li founders.
note_zh: 北魏六镇之一，宇文泰、杨忠、李虎出身于此。

name: Lingzhou
note: Seat of the Shuofang army; Suzong took the throne here in 756.
note_zh: 朔方节度使治所，756年唐肃宗在此即位。

name: Shouxiang Cities
note: Three forts built in 708 to hold the Ordos loop.
note_zh: 张仁愿筑三受降城，控制河套。

name: Puzhou (Hezhong)
note: Guards the Pujin crossing and Chang'an.
note_zh: 河中府，扼蒲津渡，拱卫长安。

name: Shangdang (Luzhou)
note: 'Who holds Shangdang holds the realm'; Changping battle nearby.
note_zh: “得上党者得天下”，长平之战、昭义镇所在。

name: Suyab
note: Westernmost Tang garrison.
note_zh: 唐安西四镇之一，最西的唐城。

name: Xiongzhou
note: Song–Liao border town and market.
note_zh: 宋辽边界，白沟河榷场。

name: Gu
note: Early capital of Zhongshan.
note_zh: 中山国早期都城。

name: Dingzhou
note: Song frontier base behind the water defences.
note_zh: 宋河北边防重镇，设塘泊防线。

name: Yanzhou
note: Song–Xia front, held by Fan Zhongyan.
note_zh: 宋夏前线，范仲淹镇守。

name: Diaoyu Fortress
note: Song hill fort; Möngke Khan died before it in 1259.
note_zh: 南宋山城，1259年蒙哥汗死于城下。

name: Piantou Pass
note: Ming Shanxi garrison, one of the Nine Frontiers.
note_zh: 明山西镇（偏头关），九边之一。

name: Uliastai
note: Seat of the Qing general over Khalkha Mongolia.
note_zh: 清定边左副将军驻地，统辖喀尔喀。

name: Khovd
note: Seat of the Qing Khovd amban.
note_zh: 清科布多参赞大臣驻地。

name: Aigun
note: First seat of the Heilongjiang general; 1858 treaty.
note_zh: 黑龙江将军初驻地，1858年《瑷珲条约》。

name: Ningguta
note: Seat of the Ningguta general; place of exile.
note_zh: 宁古塔将军驻地，清流放之地。

name: Jilin Ula
note: Seat of the Jilin general and shipyard.
note_zh: 吉林将军驻地，松花江船厂。

name: Jiang (Yi)
note: Capital of Jin until the move to Xintian in 585 BCE.
note_zh: 晋国都城（翼，后称绛），前585年迁新田。

name: Zhaoge
note: Late Shang seat, then capital of Wey until the Di sacked it in 660 BCE.
note_zh: 商末都邑，后为卫国都城，前660年为狄所破。

name: Chuqiu
note: Wey's capital rebuilt with Qi's help.
note_zh: 齐桓公助卫复国所筑新都。

name: Diqiu
note: Later capital of Wey.
note_zh: 卫国后期都城。

name: Danyang
note: Early Chu capital (location disputed; placed at the Dan–Xi confluence).
note_zh: 楚国早期都城（地望有争议，此取丹淅之会说）。

name: Xichui
note: Early Qin seat; Qin dukes' tombs at Dabuzishan.
note_zh: 秦人早期居邑（西犬丘），大堡子山秦公墓所在。

name: Pingyang
note: Qin seat near the Qian–Wei confluence, then Pingyang, before Yong.
note_zh: 秦文公居汧渭之会，宪公迁平阳，前677年迁雍。

name: Shangcai
note: Capital of Cai until Chu took it in 531 BCE.
note_zh: 蔡国都城，前531年为楚所灭，后复国迁新蔡。

name: Xincai
note: Cai's capital after it was restored.
note_zh: 蔡平侯复国后都城。

name: Xiacai
note: Cai's last capital, taken by Chu in 447 BCE.
note_zh: 蔡昭侯迁州来，称下蔡，前447年为楚所灭。

name: Ju
note: Capital of Ju, taken by Chu in 431 BCE.
note_zh: 莒国都城，前431年为楚所灭。

name: Lingshou
note: Capital of Zhongshan until Zhao conquered it in 296 BCE.
note_zh: 中山国都城，前296年为赵所灭。

name: Meili
note: Early Wu seat said to be founded by Taibo (location disputed).
note_zh: 相传泰伯所居，吴国早期都邑（地望有争议）。

name: Bizhong
note: Early Yue seat, traditionally placed at Zhuji.
note_zh: 越国早期都邑（传说在诸暨）。

name: Xu
note: Capital of Xu, conquered by Wu in 512 BCE.
note_zh: 徐国都城，前512年为吴所灭。

name: Xing
note: Capital of Xing until the Di sacked it in 661 BCE.
note_zh: 邢国都城，前661年为狄所破，迁夷仪。

name: Shangyang
note: Capital of Guo, destroyed by Jin in 655 BCE.
note_zh: 虢国都城，前655年晋假道伐虢而灭。

name: Sui (Zeng)
note: Seat of Sui (Zeng); Marquis Yi of Zeng's bells found nearby.
note_zh: 随（曾）国都邑，出土曾侯乙编钟。

name: Huang
note: Capital of Huang, taken by Chu in 648 BCE.
note_zh: 黄国都城，前648年为楚所灭。

name: Lai
note: Seat of Lai, conquered by Qi in 567 BCE.
note_zh: 莱国都邑，前567年为齐所灭。

name: Shangyong
note: Capital of Yong, taken by Chu in 611 BCE.
note_zh: 庸国都城，前611年为楚所灭。
